correctness.rationale: Fourier positivity on the Boolean group is reconstructed exactly as one inequality for every graph cut. The signed cut-packing transform is reversible because a random-cut average forces total signed weight below two. Blow-up lifting is feasible by interpreting every lifted cut weight as an expectation of a base-cut weight; the reverse direction follows from within-cluster symmetrization and whole-cluster cuts. The complete-multipartite corollary then follows from an independent symmetric computation on the base clique. Exact-rational finite checks reproduce the stated extremizers but are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Vertex blow-up is a natural graph operation, and the theorem shows that a nontrivial harmonic-analysis extremum is exactly insensitive to every positive multiplicity. The corollary computes an infinite family of generally non-edge-transitive supports, including arbitrarily unbalanced complete multipartite graphs, from one structural principle. This is materially broader than recomputing isolated examples and provides a reusable reduction for future edge-shell Turán questions.
